This is a Vite + React + TypeScript frontend for a Starknet contract. Use starknet.js for all contract and wallet interactions. Scaffold UI for connect wallet, add bet (admin), place bet (up/down), view bet, and claim reward. Use the contract ABI and address as provided by the user.
